senses.gloss: the founder of a sect similar to that of the Sadducees, named בַּיְיתוֹסִין Boëthusians. Ab. d’R. Nath. ch. V.
father of one Martha or Miriam, a rich woman in the days of the siege of Jerusalem by Titus.
